name: Wroughtweiler
source_text: When this card is destroyed as a result of battle and sent to the Graveyard, add from your Graveyard to your hand 1 card that includes "Elemental Hero" in its card name, and 1 "Polymerization".
notes: Two explicit Graveyard searches; the deterministic selector takes the first matching card.
